issue.title: [agents] Добавьте скилл графа зависимостей задач спринта
issue.body:
## Background

Зависимости задач спринта видны по кусочкам: blocked-by и sub-issues ставят руками (эпик #139), остальное — текстом в Dependencies. В начале спринта нет одной картины: что можно брать параллельно, что на критическом пути, кто кого ждёт. Координация идёт в чате.

На доске 12 уже есть представления Blocking, Blocked и Free to start (views/5, 6, 7 — фильтры `is:blocking` / `is:blocked`), но они видят связи поштучно. Скрипт добавляет то, чего в них нет: граф через оба репо, критический путь, циклы и мягкие пересечения (In Progress с открытым блокером, задачи без связей).

Решение команды (#273): после заведения задач спринта строим граф и публикуем его в issue «Спринт N» (для Спринта 4 — #261).

## Scope

- Ч.1 (PR в ui → копия в api): скрипт без LLM. Вход — майлстоун (оба репо), эпик (sub-issues) или список номеров. Читает через GraphQL `subIssues`, `parent`, `blockedBy`, `blocking`, статус на доске 12. Выход — Mermaid (GitHub рендерит его в комментариях), слои «что можно брать параллельно», критический путь, циклы, задачи без связей, «In Progress, но есть открытый блокер»
- Ч.2 (PR): `SKILL.md` и публикация — один комментарий с маркером в issue, заданном явно `--publish-to <N>` (по #273 — issue «Спринт N» без sub-issues; для Спринта 4 — #261), при повторном запуске обновляется на месте; без `--publish-to` — режим «только показать»
- Вне скоупа: угадывание связей моделью — связи ставит человек через create-issue

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Ч.1: на фикстуре с циклом скрипт называет цикл и выходит с ненулевым кодом; на фикстуре без связей выдаёт список «без связей»
- [x] Ч.1: граф собирает узлы из ui и api по майлстоуну с одинаковым названием
- [x] Ч.1: офлайн-тесты на фикстурах GraphQL, в том числе фикстура, где sub-issues и blocked-by больше `first:N` — пагинация собирает все; живой прогон на эпике #139 приложен к PR, Mermaid рендерится
- [x] Ч.2: повторный запуск с `--publish-to <N>` обновляет тот же комментарий по маркеру, а не добавляет новый; без `--publish-to` ничего не публикуется
- [x] Ч.2: задача In Progress с открытым блокером помечена в отчёте
- [x] Ч.2: 3+ золотых примера лежат в `.agents/skills/<скилл>/examples/`; вывод ручного прогона скилла в Claude Code и Codex — в описании PR

## Dependencies

**Блокирующие:**

- нет — нативные связи уже есть у части задач (#139)

**Блокирует:**

- #273 — ритуал старта спринта использует этот скилл

**Связано, не блокирует:**

- #262 — create-issue начнёт ставить связи при заведении

## DoD Checklist

- [x] Гейты CI зелёные во всех PR задачи
- [x] Документы обновлены
- [x] PR одобрены на текущей голове, все треды закрыты
- [x] Статус на доске 12 обновлён
- [x] SYNC-копии в ui и api совпадают (`diff -r` пуст)

## References

- https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/objects#issue — `subIssues`, `blockedBy`, `blocking`
- Эпик #139

## Kickoff — с чего начать

**Репозиторий:** larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6 первым, затем larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6 (SYNC)

**Ветка:** `feat/<n>-issue-graph` — части отдельными PR с `Refs larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6#<n>`. SYNC-копия — та же Ч.N: второй PR в другом репо с тем же `Refs`, порядок — сначала ui, потом копия в api (`.agents/README.md:77`). Отдельный sub-issue — только если часть меняет разный код в двух репо

**Форма проблемы:** Граф задач уже частично лежит в GitHub нативными связями, но его никто не видит целиком. Нужен детерминированный скрипт, который собирает связи по майлстоуну из обоих репо и выдаёт картину, пригодную для решения «кто что берёт первым», плюс публикация, которую можно перезапускать без мусора.

**Что прочитать первым:**

- `gh api graphql` с `subIssues` на эпике #139 — форма данных
- `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` — статусы доски 12
- `.agents/skills/create-issue/scripts/` — как в команде устроены CLI-скрипты скиллов и их тесты

**Перед тем как писать код:**

- Сверить с готовыми скиллами (Matt Pocock, Addy Osmani, OpenSpec); в PR одной строкой — что взято, что нет и почему. Сверка со скиллами куратора (созвон 26.10) старт не блокирует; если материалы придут позже — строка сверки в ревью PR
- Записать 3+ золотых примера до написания SKILL.md — по ним скилл и принимается. Золотые примеры лежат в `.agents/skills/<скилл>/examples/`: вход (issue/PR/фикстура) и ожидаемый результат. Детерминированные части скрипта — pytest рядом со скиллом, запуск как у create-issue (вне CI, `create-issue/SKILL.md:234-240`); поведение скилла автор PR прогоняет вручную в Claude Code и Codex и прикладывает вывод в описание PR

**Мины:**

- Майлстоуны отдельные в каждом репо — сопоставлять по названию
- Пагинация GraphQL (`first: 50`) у `subIssues` и `blockedBy`; у эпика #139 ровно 9 sub-issues, у #261 — 13, поэтому живой прогон пагинацию не проверит — нужна фикстура больше `first:N`
- Mermaid: id узлов без `#` и `/` (`api_139`), заголовки экранировать и обрезать
- Rate limit GraphQL: один запрос на репо с вложенными связями, а не запрос на каждый issue
- Не опираться на определения `.agents/agents/*.md` (Codex их не грузит); изоляция шагов — по `.agents/README.md`, раздел про субагентов в харнессах (у Codex есть `spawn_agent`)
- Какие пути скиллов и AGENTS.md читают харнессы из матрицы `.agents/README.md` — проверить по их документации, не по памяти
- Общего модуля GraphQL с #262 и #266 нет: каждый скилл самодостаточен (SYNC), дублирование запросов принято
- gh 2.46 в этой org падает на `gh issue view` без `--json` и на `gh pr edit` (Projects classic) — только `--json` или `gh api`
- Общий скилл правится в ui, затем `cp` в api и `diff -r` (`.agents/README.md:58-78`); `SKILL.md` — до ~250 строк, детали в `references/` (`.agents/README.md:88`); новый скилл — в список в `AGENTS.md` и в sync map `.agents/README.md`
- `.agents/README.md:49` («8 here») — счёт скиллов меняется, поправить в том же PR

source.title: feat(agents): add the issue-graph script for sprint dependency graphs
source.body:
## What

Part 1 of api#268: a deterministic script, `.agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py`, that builds the dependency graph of a sprint from GitHub native relations. It uses no LLM. The `SKILL.md` and publishing come in part 2.

- **Input**:
  - a milestone, matched by exact title in api and ui;
  - an epic's sub-issues;
  - or a list of `api#N` / `ui#N` / `owner/name#N`.
- **Reads**: `parent`, `blockedBy`, `blocking` and the Status on board 12, through `gh api graphql`. It sends one query per repo with the relations nested, not one query per issue. The scope is paginated by 50, and so are nested `blockedBy`/`blocking` (follow-up `node(id:)` pages).
- **Output**: a Markdown report on stdout.
  - A Mermaid graph. Sub-issues are drawn inside their parent's subgraph. A closed blocker is a dotted edge. Each node has a status class (done / In Progress / On Review·AC Check / alarm / outside the scope).
  - Cycles.
  - In Progress issues that have an open blocker.
  - Parallel layers. Layer 1 is "can be taken now".
  - The critical path.
  - Issues without links.
  - Issues outside the scope.
- **Exit codes**:
  - `0` — report printed;
  - `1` — report printed and the graph has a cycle; layers and critical path are not computed;
  - `2` — input error, including a NOT_FOUND ref or a milestone that is in no repo;
  - `3` — gh / GraphQL failure.
- **Tests**: offline pytest on GraphQL fixtures. They use the `ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR` seam, and an autouse fake `gh` fails any real call. Six byte-exact golden reports, written by hand before the code: `cycle`, `no-links`, `milestone` (ui + api, container, cross-repo edge, external blocker, tie-break), `epic` (the shape of #139), `pagination`, `issues`. 59 tests.
- **Sync** (api copy: larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6#275): `.agents/README.md` lists `skills/issue-graph/**` in the sync map and notes that JSON fixtures carry no marker. Its goldens and fixtures are added to `.prettierignore`.

No new dependency: python3 stdlib only, as in `create-issue`.

`skills/issue-graph/` has no `SKILL.md` until part 2. Harnesses that look for `SKILL.md` skip the directory until then. The script and its tests stand alone.

## Why

The sprint's dependencies are visible only in pieces. blocked-by and sub-issues are set by hand, and the rest lives as text in Dependencies. Team decision in api#273: build the graph once the sprint's issues are filed, and publish it in the sprint epic. This part provides the graph. Publishing and the skill come in part 2.

**Compared with existing skills** (repo heads read 2026-10-24):

- **mattpocock/skills** `wayfinder`/`to-tickets`. Taken: native blockedBy as the source of truth, and the "frontier" rule, which here is layer 1. Not taken: his `Blocked by:` fallback that parses issue text. We read native relations only.
- **addyosmani/agent-skills** `planning-and-task-breakdown`. Not taken: its graph is drawn by hand. Ours comes from data and cannot drift.
- **OpenSpec**, the `add-change-stacking-awareness` proposal. Taken: cycles are reported before layering, and ties have a deterministic tie-break. Not taken: `provides/requires` markers, since GitHub has nothing to hold them.
- None of the three computes a critical path or publishes a graph to GitHub.
- The curator's set promised after the 26.10 call has not been received yet. It will be compared before part 2.

**OpenCode** ([skills](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/), [rules](https://opencode.ai/docs/rules/), docs dated 2026-10-23) reads `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`, and `AGENTS.md` (`CLAUDE.md` only when there is no `AGENTS.md`). Our `.claude/skills` is a symlink onto `.agents/skills`, so OpenCode sees every skill twice. Its docs do not say which copy wins. This applies to all skills, not only this one. `OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILLS=1` turns the `.claude/skills` path off.

## How to verify

```sh
# offline tests (not part of the required CI job — same decision as create-issue)
uv run --no-project --with pytest pytest -p no:cacheprovider .agents/skills/issue-graph/tests
# byte-identity with the api copy (api PR: larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6#275)
diff -r ../dmc-268-api-t6/.agents/skills/issue-graph .agents/skills/issue-graph
# live: the board Status needs the read:project scope (default gh login lacks it)
gh auth refresh -s read:project
.agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --epic api#139
.agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4"
```

ruff (`check` and `format --check`) and `mypy --strict` run against the api copy, because ui has no Python toolchain. The api PR lists the commands. The tests also pass under api's pytest config.

Review before opening: one clean-context review in two rounds. The first round raised no P1. Its P2 findings were gaps in the tests (closed blockers, cursors on the wire, nested pages past p2), and they are closed with mutation checks. Its P3 findings are applied too. One ambiguity was settled: an out-of-scope issue that only waits on an in-scope one renders as `— ждёт <ref>`, with no «блокирует».

Titles outside the Mermaid block get a zero-width space after `#` and `@`, written as `​`. The GitHub markdown API showed that `\#` and `#` still produce issue links and mentions, so `​` is the only one of the three that stops the published report from cross-linking issues or pinging people. Code spans are left untouched.

`issue_graph.py --epic api#139`, exit 0, run on 2026-10-24. The report shows the external blockers api#130 and api#219 and the chain 144 → 146 → 147.

source.title: feat(llm): route the verifier through the gateway (#130)
source.body:
## What

PR E of the #130 remainder (phase 2): the verifier gets its own model route through the LLM gateway. The path stays dormant: `ReflectionPass` is still not constructed in `app/`, so live reviews are unchanged (see Live-path impact).

- **Verifier route** — `LLM_VERIFIER_MODEL` / `LLM_VERIFIER_FALLBACK_MODEL` (read only when set, validated like the existing routes; defaults = the review pair `LLM_MODEL` / `LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL`), `LlmSettings.verifier_route()`, and `StructuredTask.route` (default `"review"`) that picks the gateway's model pair, context window and fallback slot. `.env.example` and `docs/SECRETS.md` list the variables.
- **Counter parity** — tests pin that the gateway estimates with the pinned task counter (no max, tech-lead decision) and that counter/v2 equals the profile `chars_per_token` heuristic for every `from_env` profile. `_estimate` is unchanged.
- **Bounded repair (R16)** — behind `StructuredTask.bounded_repair`, off for live review and conventions: the repair turn is one user message with the previous answer cut to 24 000 characters and XML-escaped, the validator errors capped at 20 × 300 characters and escaped, and a service instruction.
- **Accepted call and Retry-After** — `GatewayResult.accepted_call_id` (the manifest `call_id` of the accepted answer) and `LlmCallFailed.retry_after_s` (on both final raises; the verifier caps it at one day). `classify_failure` does not read it.
- **Verifier port** — `VerifierModel.verify` receives the verifier `manifest` and the review `context`, and may return `VerifierReply(output, accepted_call_id)`.
- **`GatewayVerifierModel` adapter** (`llm/models.py`) — operation `"verification"` on the verifier route: usage ledger, admission, output reserve; a `verifier-output.schema.v1.json` / `VerificationOutput` error gets one repair, then the verifier fallback (candidate-ID and reference checks stay in `ReflectionPass`, without repair). A verifier-route call waits at most 90 s on either engine. Its `llm.call` records carry the pinned verifier prompt id or none, never the review prompt id.
- **Error mapping** (`reflection_pass.py`) — 402 → `llm_payment_required`, terminal; context overflow → `verification_context_overflow`; 429 → `verification_unavailable` with the provider Retry-After, so `RetryDelays` gives 2m / 10m. `run_failures.py` is unchanged.
- **R13 trace** — run_action `llm.verify`, request `{candidate_ids, accepted_call_id, manifest_id: null}`, response `{decisions}` without `reason`, written once per run in the publishing transaction (`enter_publishing`) before `review.postprocess`. Contract: `llm.verify` joins `RUN_ACTION_TOOLS` and two `contracts/openapi.yaml` descriptions (RunStatus, RunAction.tool) as "not live yet"; no schema change.
- **R9 answer schema** — chosen by the bound review prompt version: v4 → `review-output.schema.v2.json` with a v2 validator; v1–v3 or no snapshot → v1; any other version → `SNAPSHOT_INTEGRITY_ERROR` before any call.
- **Worker** — `execution_profile_of` pins `verifier_model` / `fallback_verifier_model` from the verifier route.
- **Call reserve** — dormant `StructuredTask.reserved_calls` (default 0) takes slots out of the shared cap of 4 for that task; F sets the values.
- Plan and task list: `docs/plans/130-verifier-gateway-{plan,todo}.md`. New test fakes are shared in `tests/llm_fakes.py`.
- No new dependency, no migration, no prompt or seed change.

## Why

#130 remainder R9, R11, R13 (narrowed by the tech lead: a run_action, no migration, no `reason`), R16, and counter parity (р.4 №2 of the #230 review). Before this PR the gateway had one model pair, a gateway-backed verifier turned 402 / overflow / 429 into a retryable failure, verifier decisions were only logged under the reviewer's call id, every review answer was held to the v1 schema, and repair re-sent the raw answer as an assistant turn (RFS §8.1). The verifier path stays dormant until PR F builds `ReflectionPass(GatewayVerifierModel(...))` in the worker.

Tech-lead decisions (2026-10-24, plan OQ-1..OQ-6): R9 keys on the bound review prompt version; dormant reserve (OQ-2 = A); bounded repair gated off for live; `manifest_id = null`; a 24 000-character bound; no deploy plumbing in E.

### Live-path impact

None on live reviews. Each pin:

| Task | What a live run sees | Why it is safe, and the pinning test |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `LLM_VERIFIER_*` is parsed at worker start, only when set | Neither staging nor `.env.example` sets it. An invalid value fails start like any `LLM_*` variable. Test: an unset environment gives `verifier_route() == (primary, fallback)`. |
| 2, 5 | New fields with defaults (`route="review"`, `accepted_call_id`, `retry_after_s`) | `classify_failure` does not read `retry_after_s`. Test: `classify_failure(LlmCallFailed(RATE_LIMITED, …, retry_after_s=300)).retry_after is None`. The review task built without `route` asserts the default. |
| 3 | Nothing: Task 3 adds tests only | Parity test: `input_tokens_estimate` is identical with no counter and with `counter/v2`, for both `KNOWN_MODELS`. |
| 4 | Nothing: `bounded_repair` defaults to `False` | `tests/test_llm_gateway.py:1209` (review) and `:2910` (conventions) stay green unchanged. **Gated, live unchanged** (OQ-3, decided). |
| 6–9 | Nothing: no `ReflectionPass` in the worker; the `enter_publishing` kwargs default to `None` | A PG test shows that a legacy store writes no `llm.verify`. |
| 10 | Nothing: without a snapshot the v1 schema and validator are used | Test: the request `response_format` equals the v1 file without annotations. |
| 11 | Same pinned values with a default environment | `tests/test_review_context_stage.py:815-833` stays green unchanged. |
| 12 | Nothing: `reserved_calls` defaults to 0 | Today's cap path is pinned (the verifier entering at 4 calls fails with `llm_unavailable`, byte-identical message). |
| Round 1 | The verifier route's call timeout is capped at 90 s; review and conventions read the same engine value as before | The two `review` rows of `test_a_verifier_call_waits_at_most_90_seconds_on_either_engine`. |

### Known limitations and deviations

- **р.4 №2 is closed by a parity test, not a max.** A max in the gateway alone would refuse a prompt the counter/v1 fitter produced (`tests/test_repo_conventions.py:1312`). Remaining risk: a cost-cap overshoot on counter/v1 snapshots only, which the live worker never pins.
- `manifest_id` is `null` until manifests are persisted.
- `LLM_VERIFIER_*` is not plumbed to staging/prod (compose, `env-file.sh`, CI), so the defaults apply there. That is PR F.
- With `LLM_VERIFIER_MODEL` equal to `LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL`, the verifier "fallback" repeats the same model and spends a call slot.
- Open items for PR F:
  - `reserved_calls=1` changes the live chain: after C1 the review's second call is its fallback, not a repair (the CVS §7.3 example `C1 → R1 → R2 repair → V1` holds only without a fallback). It needs the tech lead's sign-off before F sets it.
  - `llm.call` stores the raw verifier answer, including `reason` (up to 600 characters × 10), in `run_actions.response`; "no `reason`" holds only for `llm.verify`.
  - `accepted_call_id` is a manifest id and `llm.call` carries no `call_id`, so the two cannot be joined until it does.
  - Bounded repair sends two consecutive user turns (`[system, user, user]`); smoke-test that shape on the provider (EUrouter / Mistral).
- Docs for G (nothing in them becomes false on this merge): PIPELINE_SPEC `:115` and `:177` (`llm.verify` is written in the publishing transaction, before `review.postprocess`; `manifest_id`; no `reason`), CVS §7.3 / §7.4 (per-task reserve, V2 as a fallback, no money or time reserve for the verifier), RFS §7.2 / §8.1 (separate verifier pair, the parity rule, bounded previous output), SECRETS / CICD (`LLM_VERIFIER_*` on staging). The full list is in the plan.

### Coordination

Comments are posted in #227, #229, #283, #220 and #254. Textual merges are clean (0 conflicts in a 3-way merge), but tests break for whoever merges second:

- #283: its strict `enter_publishing` fake (`tests/test_clean_without_text_result.py`) does not accept the new `verify_request` / `verify_response` kwargs, which `StoreReviewOutput` now always passes, so that test raises TypeError.
- #227: `FindingPostProcessingInput.checked_paths` becomes required (`tests/test_llm_verify_trace.py`), and `insert_run_action` requires `attempt >= 1` (the new PG tests seed attempt 0).
- #229: `hunk_lines` → `diff_map` breaks the same constructor call.
- #227's `llm_operation` allow-list has no `verification`; verifier `llm.call` rows carry `operation="verification"`.

## How to verify

```
uv run ruff check .
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run mypy . --exclude '^docs/reports/'
TEST_DATABASE_URL=<local postgres URL> uv run pytest tests/test_gateway_accepted_call.py \
  tests/test_gateway_answer_validation.py tests/test_gateway_call_reserve.py \
  tests/test_gateway_counter_parity.py tests/test_gateway_repair_envelope.py \
  tests/test_gateway_verifier_model.py tests/test_llm_verifier_route.py \
  tests/test_llm_verify_trace.py tests/test_llm_verify_trace_postgres.py \
  tests/test_reflection_pass.py tests/test_execute_review.py tests/test_openapi_contract.py
```

source.body:
## What Part 2 (Ч.2) of #262, byte-identical mirror of larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6#179 (source of truth): the shared `create-issue` skill slices a big task into PR-sized parts and files several linked issues as one batch with one confirmation. > Part 1 (#278) is merged and this PR targets `main`. Part 3 (#286) was merged into this branch, as larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6#180 was in ui, so the diff carries parts 2 and 3: `.agents/skills/qa/SKILL.md` is part 3. Rebased onto `main` after #275 (#268); the `.agents/README.md` SYNC-marker paragraph names both the issue-graph and the create-issue `examples/` files. - **Parts.** New spec key `parts` (≥ 2 entries, each `scope`, `boundary`, `done_when`, `acceptance_criteria`). The builder renders them in Scope as «Ч.N (отдельный PR)» with «Граница PR» and «Готово, когда», and in Acceptance Criteria as «Ч.N: …» (en/de labels too). `done_when` is the stop criterion: a command with its expected result. - **Slicing rule** (`references/slicing.md`): slice when the work needs more than one PR, changes different code in more than one repo, or has parts that can go in parallel. A part «Ч.N» is a separate PR in the same issue by default (as in CONTRIBUTING «Приёмка задачи»). The SYNC copy of a shared file is the same part, a second PR in the other repo with the same `Refs`. A sub-issue only when the part changes different code in two repos, goes to another assignee or runs in parallel. Each part has its own AC, PR boundary and stop criterion. Also a «ready for a weak model» checklist: paths, verification commands with the expected result, pitfalls, one PR per part, nothing that needs a sub-agent. Decomposition is not an implementation plan: the plan ban in `templates.md` stays, the no-bulk ban in `SKILL.md` is lifted. - **Batch mode** (`scripts/issue-batch.py`, `references/batch.md`): - A batch file `{"id", "items": [spec + "key"]}`; `parent` / `blocked_by` may point at another item as `@key`. - Before anything is created: shape, keys, unknown or self refs, cycles, the parent's owner, every item through the builder, then the remote checks of part 1 (`issue-create.sh --dry-run`) for every item still to create. Any failure creates nothing. - Order: parents before children, blockers before what they block, ties in file order. - One preview (a table plus every body) and ONE confirmation for the batch: the structured question tool where the harness has one, otherwise the explicit reply `Create` / «Создать». - Each result goes to a state file (`${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-~/.cache}/create-issue/batches/.json`, written atomically after every item). A rerun resumes: recorded items are not created again and their links are re-ensured. - An exact-title duplicate is adopted only on a rerun of the same batch, and only if it is open, opened by you and created after the batch started (with a 120 s clock-skew allowance). The plain issue listing is checked as well as the search, because the search index lags. Anything else (a first run, a closed issue, a teammate's or an older one) stops with exit 4 and names the issue. The preview already shows «would adopt #N» or «would stop: duplicate #N». - Exit codes: 2/3/4/5 stop the batch, 6 (board) and 7 (links) do not; the final code is 7, else 6, else 0. Outcomes recorded in earlier runs count too. - **Prose-only blocker warning**: a `dependencies` group labelled «Blocked by» / «Блокирующие» / «Блокируется» / «Blockiert durch» with no `blocked_by` gives a builder warning (exit code unchanged) and a line under «Warnings» in the batch preview. - **`issue-create.sh`**: the dry-run also reports an exact-title duplicate; exit 4 prints the duplicate as JSON on stdout; new `--adopt-since` for the driver. - **Golden examples** (`examples/01-single`, `02-two-prs`, `03-ui-api`): `input.md` (the request in plain words) → `batch.json`, `preview.md` (byte-compared with the real `--dry-run`) and `expected.md` (number of parts, PR or sub-issue, repo). `issue-batch.py --compare-shape GOLDEN CANDIDATE` compares two batches by shape: repos, the parent/blocked-by graph, the number of parts, AC and `done_when` in every part, kickoff `read_first` / `mines`. - `.agents/README.md`: the SYNC-marker rule covers `examples/` (`batch.json` has none, JSON has no comments). - Review round 1 (createunix, two P3), in the last two commits (ui 430e4a1 and bd0341d): a blocked-by group that only says there are no blockers («нет», «Нет.», «Нет: …», none, keine) no longer triggers the prose-blocker warning; when a first run stops on an exact-title duplicate that is your own, open and under 24 h old (the state file of an earlier run may be lost: new container, other machine, other `XDG_CACHE_HOME`), the stop prints the whole state file to write and says not to rename the item; a rerun's hint says the same. A first run still never adopts. - Tests 412 → 706 passed. `SKILL.md` 249 lines (budget ~250). No new dependency. ## Why The skill forbade batches and any plan, so a big task was sliced differently by everyone or not at all, and «Хвосты приёмки» piled up after merges (17 open). Weak models (Codex, OpenCode with GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek) finish a task when it comes sliced into PR-sized parts with their own AC; strong models are not hurt by it. Prior art: we took vertical slicing, size-based split signals and per-task files/dependencies from addyosmani/agent-skills `planning-and-task-breakdown`, in-line verification per task with tests landing in the same slice from OpenSpec `tasks.md`, and the approve-then-publish loop, blockers-first creation and native sub-issue/blocked-by links (REST, database ids) from mattpocock/skills `to-tickets`/`wayfinder`. We left out Pocock's no-file-paths rule (a weak executor needs paths and commands) and the one-slice-one-issue mapping (our parts are PRs inside one issue unless the assignee, repo or parallelism differs). The stop criterion, the weak-model checklist and the idempotent rerun have no upstream equivalent. The batch design follows the tech lead's personal `create-issue` skill (`bulk-mode.md`). Curator's skills: the skill files are not sent yet («Скиллы эти я вам потом отправлю», demo 23.10 [00:41:08]) and choosing and validating skills is on the 26.10 call, so this line is drawn from the demo of the lecturer's `task planner` [00:43:12]–[00:44:52]. Taken: tasks written «как будто для джуна», so the executor spends no context exploring the code — the same aim as our weak-model checklist (paths, commands with the expected result, pitfalls) and per-part AC. Not taken: «планировщик продумывает всю имплементацию» (implementation details and a diagram inside the task) — the plan ban in `templates.md` stays, because an issue outlives the code it was written against and plans are local working files (larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6#265). His `task orchestrator` loop (plan → TDD executor sub-agent → review sub-agent → approve or fix) is the implementation side, larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6#269. The tech lead decided on 25.10 not to wait for the files, so this line stands as the reconciliation. ## How to verify ```bash uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest uv run mypy .agents/skills/create-issue/scripts/build_issue_body.py .agents/skills/create-issue/scripts/issue-batch.py .agents/skills/create-issue/tests uv run pytest .agents/skills/create-issue/tests # 706 passed diff -r .agents/skills/create-issue ../dmc-268-ui-t6/.agents/skills/create-issue # empty diff -r .agents/skills/qa ../dmc-268-ui-t6/.agents/skills/qa # empty ``` **Golden replay (the skill reproduces the examples).** Blind run on the skill text at ui commit f0cb631, now ui 3fc83b0 after the rebase onto `main` (the next commit, ui dc7ce2d / api c3b90eb6, adds the prose-blocker warning below and one sentence each to `batch.md` and `templates.md`): a copy of the branch with `examples/` and `tests/` removed; each model got only `input.md` and the instruction to use this repo's skill and print the batch it would preview (read-only, nothing created). Then `--compare-shape` against the golden: | Harness / model | 01-single | 02-two-prs | 03-ui-api | |---|---|---|---| | Codex CLI 0.163, gpt-6-sol | same shape | same shape | same shape | | Claude Code, Sonnet 5.5 | same shape | same shape | same shape | | Claude Code, Haiku 5.5 | same shape | same shape | 1 of 3 runs same shape | In the two Haiku misses on 03 the ui item named its blocker only in prose (Dependencies «Блокирующие: …») and set neither `blocked_by` nor `parent` — the graph stayed in prose, the exact failure this issue is about. That is why the last commit adds a deterministic guard: the builder warns `dependencies has a "Блокирующие" group but no blocked_by — the native link will be missing`, and the batch preview lists it under «Warnings» before the one confirmation. On an earlier text of the skill (ui commit 35d6791) Haiku got 03 right; before `--compare-shape` was narrowed to what the AC defines (parts, PR or sub-issue, repo), the only other differences were the issue type (Story instead of the golden Task) and the number of AC per part (02: 4/3 and 3/3 instead of 2/2). source.body: ## What Part 2 of api#268: publishing and the skill around the part-1 script (ui#177). - **`--publish-to N|REF`** (`issue_graph.py`) — the report also goes to one comment whose first line is `` (`milestone=`, `epic=<repo>#<n>` or `issues=<sorted refs>`). A re-run with the same scope finds that comment (REST listing, 100 per page, oldest first, capped at 100 pages) and PATCHes it; otherwise it POSTs one. A bare `N` is `api#N`, so `--publish-to 261` targets the «Спринт 4» issue. Without `--publish-to` the script makes no REST call and the report is byte-identical to part 1 (goldens unchanged, except `cycle.md` — see review round 1 below). - **Never publishes** a graph with a cycle (report printed, exit 1) or a body over GitHub's 65536-character limit (exit 2). In fixture mode gh is still never called: comment pages come from fixtures and writes go to `ISSUE_GRAPH_WRITE_LOG`, so a fixture run cannot post a fake graph; an empty `ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR` is an error, not a live run. - **`examples/`** — four golden request/outcome pairs, written before `SKILL.md`: show a sprint graph (live), publish and re-run into the same comment (live), refuse to publish a cycle (fixture), flag In Progress work waiting on an open blocker (fixture). - **`SKILL.md`** (244 lines, one context, no sub-agents) + `references/report.md` (what each section means) + `references/publishing.md` (marker, matching, failures, fixture seam). `AGENTS.md` lists the skill. Commits, one per prompt (`docs/prompts/268/06`–`12`): the script and tests, the examples, `SKILL.md`, two clean-context review rounds (script: 2 P2 test gaps + 6 P3; skill: 3 P2 + 10 P3 — all applied), fixes from the first manual runs, and team review round 1 (`2d81cdb`): - **«Циклы» names the whole cyclic component.** Under a cycle line, one nested line `- в том же клубке связей ещё: …` lists the component's other issues in key order, tagged `(вне выборки)`, `(закрыта)` or both; a component that is just its cycle gets none. The cycle line itself is unchanged; `cycle.md` is the only golden that changed. A graph with a cycle is never published, so the comment format is not affected. - **The marker key escapes CR and LF** (`%0D`, `%0A`, after `%` and before `>`), so a multi-line milestone title still matches its comment on a re-run. Titles without them keep today's marker — the api#261 comment still matches. ## Why api#273 makes the graph part of sprint start: once the sprint's issues are filed, the milestone graph is published to the «Спринт N» issue. Re-runs during the sprint must update that one comment, not pile up new ones, and the agent must not invent links or publish a broken graph. Decisions worth a look: - **The marker is per scope, not per issue**: a milestone graph and an epic graph can live side by side in one issue. The repo set is not part of the key (a `--repo`-narrowed run updates the same comment — `SKILL.md` keeps `--repo` away from `--publish-to`); owner/name are lower-cased. - **No author filter**: a teammate's re-run updates the same comment (write access can edit others' comments). A marked comment the account cannot edit fails with exit 3 and names it — no second comment. - **Layer 1 ignores the board Status** (part 1 behaviour, goldens kept): `SKILL.md` tells the agent to name layer-1 issues already In Progress / On Review as taken instead of offering them as free. A script-side tag in the layers is possible as a follow-up. - **Harness discovery** (checked against docs, not memory): Claude Code reads `.claude/skills` (symlink to `.agents/skills`); Codex reads repo-local `.agents/skills/` ([OpenAI: skills in the Agents SDK repos](https://developers.openai.com/blog/skills-agents-sdk)). - Ready-made skills (Pocock, Osmani, OpenSpec) were compared in ui#177. The curator's skill set (call on 26.10) has not arrived; the comparison line goes into the review when it does. ## How to verify ```bash # offline tests (not part of the required CI job — same decision as create-issue) uv run --no-project --with pytest pytest -p no:cacheprovider .agents/skills/issue-graph/tests # 165 passed # byte-identity with the api copy diff -r .agents/skills/issue-graph ../dmc-268-api-t6/.agents/skills/issue-graph # a fixture example by hand: exit 1, nothing published, stderr {"error": "not published: the graph has a cycle"} ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR=.agents/skills/issue-graph/tests/fixtures/cycle \ .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --issues api#1 api#2 api#3 api#4 --publish-to 261 ``` ## Manual runs — Claude Code 2.1.310 and Codex 0.163.0 Each example's `input.md` body sent as the prompt from the repo root (`claude -p`, `codex exec`). Guard rails for the runs: a `gh` wrapper first on `PATH` that lets only GraphQL queries and REST GETs through; for fixture examples an invalid `GH_TOKEN` and Codex's `read-only` sandbox. The wrapper log holds GraphQL queries only, plus one blocked `gh auth token` lookup — no write was attempted. Round 1 (03, 04) found two gaps, fixed in `abc0b96`: Claude Code opened `examples/03…/expected.md` after the run, and Codex redrew a simplified Mermaid block and dropped the "repeat until «Циклы» reads «Нет.»" advice. Round 2 below, on `abc0b96`. After team review round 1, 03 was re-run in both harnesses on `2d81cdb` (round 3, below): both replies now name api#5 and the closed api#6 from the report's tangle line, neither opened `examples/`, and the `gh` wrapper logged no call. Remaining deviation: Codex 01 includes the report's Mermaid block verbatim (it reads «покажи граф» as asking for the picture). `02-publish-rerun` — live, run on 2026-10-25 after the tech lead's OK, strictly in sequence: Claude Code turn 1 → turn 2 (`--resume`), then Codex turn 1 → turn 2 (`codex exec resume`). The `gh` wrapper allowed exactly two writes — a POST on api#261's comments and a PATCH of an api issue comment — and logged every call: 1 POST, then 3 PATCHes of the same comment; nothing else was written. Afterwards the `expected.md` check prints one URL: exactly one marked comment, [api#261 comment 6396929696](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696). Both harnesses' turn 2 said the report did not change — true: no link was edited between the turns. <details><summary><code>02-publish-rerun</code> turn 1 — Claude Code</summary> Tool calls: ```text [Skill] issue-graph .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4" --publish-to 261; echo "EXIT=$?" ``` Reply: Граф опубликован (`created`): https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696 В майлстоуне «Спринт 4» 15 задач, все открыты. Между ними 7 связей блокировки, задач вне выборки нет. **Тревоги** - Циклов нет. - Одна задача в «In Progress» ждёт открытый блокер: **api#273 ждёт api#268**, обе задачи в выборке. Что делать, решает человек: - закрыть api#268, потом продолжать api#273; - вернуть api#273 из «In Progress»; - снять связь, если api#273 больше не ждёт api#268. **Можно брать сейчас (слой 1):** api#262, api#263, api#264, api#265, api#267, api#268, api#270, api#271, api#272, ui#175. Из них две задачи уже в работе: api#268 в статусе `progress`, api#262 в статусе `review`. **Критический путь:** api#262 → api#266 → api#269 (3 задачи). **Без связей:** - api#263 [ci] Skylos в CI api - api#264 [agents] учебный Terraform в AGENTS.md и карта чтения спек - api#267 [agents] скилл ревью PR - api#270 [ci] проверка расхождения SYNC-копий и битых ссылок - api#271 [process] кто мержит, срок первой подачи на ревью - ui#175 [ci] Skylos в CI ui Если запустить ещё раз с тем же майлстоуном, обновится этот же комментарий, новый не появится. </details> <details><summary><code>02-publish-rerun</code> turn 1 — Codex</summary> Tool calls: ```text /bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/issue-graph/SKILL.md' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc 'gh auth status' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone 'Спринт 4' --publish-to 261" # exit 0 ``` Reply: Граф спринта 4 **обновлён** в [#261](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696). Циклов нет. Задача api#273 находится в In Progress и ждёт открытую api#268. Команде нужно решить: сначала завершить блокер, вернуть api#273 из In Progress или удалить связь, если она устарела. Сейчас в первом параллельном слое: api#262, #​263, #​264, #​265, #​267, #​268, #​270, #​271, #​272 и ui#175. При этом api#262 уже на ревью, api#268 — в работе. Критический путь: **api#262 → api#266 → api#269**. Без связей: api#263, #​264, #​267, #​270, #​271 и ui#175. Задач вне выборки нет. </details> <details><summary><code>02-publish-rerun</code> turn 2 — Claude Code</summary> Tool calls: ```text .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4" --publish-to 261; echo "EXIT=$?" ``` Reply: Комментарий обновлён (`updated`), новый не создавался: https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696 **Изменения в связях этот прогон не увидел.** Отчёт полностью совпадает с прошлым: те же 15 задач и 7 связей блокировки (те же стрелки), вне выборки ничего нет. Возможно, правку не сохранили или она касается задач не из майлстоуна «Спринт 4». Отсюда это не видно. Когда правка будет в GitHub, я запущу ещё раз, если скажете. **Тревоги** - Циклов нет. - Одна задача в «In Progress» по-прежнему ждёт открытый блокер: **api#273 ждёт api#268**. Что делать, решает человек: - закрыть api#268, потом продолжать api#273; - вернуть api#273 из «In Progress»; - снять связь, если api#273 больше не ждёт api#268. **Можно брать сейчас (слой 1):** api#262, api#263, api#264, api#265, api#267, api#268, api#270, api#271, api#272, ui#175. Из них две задачи уже в работе: api#268 в статусе `progress`, api#262 в статусе `review`. **Критический путь:** api#262 → api#266 → api#269 (3 задачи). **Без связей:** api#263, api#264, api#267, api#270, api#271, ui#175. </details> <details><summary><code>02-publish-rerun</code> turn 2 — Codex</summary> Tool calls: ```text /bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone 'Спринт 4' --publish-to 261" # exit 0 ``` Reply: Граф спринта 4 [обновлён в #​261](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696). В текущем отчёте по спринту по-прежнему 7 связей блокировки; выводы совпадают с предыдущим запуском. Циклов нет. api#273 находится в In Progress и ждёт открытую api#268. Команда может завершить блокер, вернуть api#273 из In Progress или удалить связь, если она устарела. Сейчас в первом параллельном слое: api#262, #​263, #​264, #​265, #​267, #​268, #​270, #​271, #​272 и ui#175. api#262 уже на ревью, api#268 — в работе. Критический путь: **api#262 → api#266 → api#269**. Без связей: api#263, #​264, #​267, #​270, #​271 и ui#175. Задач вне выборки нет. </details> <details><summary><code>01-show-sprint</code> — Claude Code</summary> Tool calls: ```text [Skill] issue-graph .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4"; echo "EXIT=$?" ``` Reply: Граф спринта 4: 15 задач, все открыты, 7 связей блокировки. Скрипт завершился с кодом 0, в GitHub ничего не публиковал. **Тревоги** - Циклов нет. - In Progress с открытым блокером: api#273 ждёт api#268. Блокер входит в выборку. Варианты, решает человек: - сначала закончить api#268, потом продолжить api#273; - вернуть api#273 из «In Progress»; - снять связь, если api#273 на самом деле больше не ждёт api#268. **Можно брать сейчас (слой 1)** api#262, api#263, api#264, api#265, api#267, api#268, api#270, api#271, api#272, ui#175. Две из них уже в работе: api#268 в статусе In Progress, api#262 на ревью. Задач «вне выборки» в слое нет. Следующие слои: - **Слой 2:** api#266, api#273, api#287. - **Слой 3:** api#269. **Критический путь** api#262 → api#266 → api#269 (3 задачи). Головная задача api#262 уже на ревью, поэтому быстрее всего путь продвинет её мерж. **Без связей** - api#263: Skylos в CI api - api#264: учебный Terraform в AGENTS.md и карта чтения больших спек - api#267: скилл ревью PR - api#270: CI-проверка расхождения SYNC-копий и битых ссылок - api#271: мержит автор или техлид; первая подача на ревью к пятнице - ui#175: Skylos в CI ui **Предупреждения:** вне выборки ничего, майлстоун найден в обоих репозиториях. Могу опубликовать граф в issue «Спринт 4» (#​261) — `--publish-to 261`. </details> <details><summary><code>01-show-sprint</code> — Codex</summary> Tool calls: ```text /bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/issue-graph/SKILL.md' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc 'gh auth status' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4"' # exit 0 ``` Reply: ### Спринт 4 Циклов нет. Есть одна задача в работе с открытым блокером: [api#273](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/273) ждёт [api#268](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/268). Команда может сначала завершить блокер, вернуть #​273 из In Progress либо удалить связь, если она устарела. **Можно брать параллельно сейчас:** [api#262](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/262), [#263](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/263), [#264](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/264), [#265](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/265), [#267](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/267), [#268](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/268), [#270](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/270), [#271](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/271), [#272](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/272) и [ui#175](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6/issues/175). При этом #​262 уже на ревью, а #​268 в работе. **Критический путь:** [api#262](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/262) → [api#266](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/266) → [api#269](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/269). После первого слоя параллельно открываются #​266, #​273 и #​287; #​269 идёт следующим слоем. **Без связей блокировки:** api#263, #​264, #​267, #​270, #​271 и ui#175. Задач вне выборки нет. ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph api_261["api#35;261 Эпик: доработки процесса и скиллов кома…"] api_262["api#35;262 Ставьте нативные связи и нарезку на час…"] api_263["api#35;263 Добавьте Skylos в CI api: мёртвый код и…"] api_264["api#35;264 Пометьте в AGENTS.md учебный Terraform …"] api_265["api#35;265 Уберите docs/plans из репозиториев: пла…"] api_266["api#35;266 Добавьте скилл приёмки задачи: AC Check…"] api_267["api#35;267 Добавьте скилл ревью PR: оси Standards,…"] api_268["api#35;268 Добавьте скилл графа зависимостей задач…"] api_269["api#35;269 Добавьте скилл реализации задачи: обёрт…"] api_270["api#35;270 Проверяйте в CI расхождение SYNC-копий …"] api_271["api#35;271 Мержит автор или техлид; первая подача …"] api_272["api#35;272 Приёмка: самопроверка автора, выборочна…"] api_273["api#35;273 Спринты: майлстоун на каждый спринт и г…"] ui_175["ui#35;175 Добавьте Skylos в CI ui: мёртвый код и …"] end api_287["api#35;287 Укрепите пакетный режим: повтор после с…"] api_262 --> api_266 api_262 --> api_269 api_262 --> api_287 api_265 --> api_269 api_266 --> api_269 api_268 --> api_273 api_272 --> api_266 classDef done fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#adb5bd,color:#868e96 classDef progress fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529 classDef review fill:#fff9db,stroke:#f08c00,color:#212529 classDef alarm fill:#fff5f5,stroke:#e03131,stroke-width:3px,color:#212529 classDef external fill:#ffffff,stroke:#868e96,stroke-dasharray:5 5,color:#212529 class api_268 progress class api_262 review class api_273 alarm ``` Могу опубликовать граф в issue «Спринт 4» (#​261). </details> <details><summary><code>03-cycle-no-publish</code> — Claude Code (round 3, <code>2d81cdb</code>)</summary> Tool calls: ```text [Skill] issue-graph ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR=.agents/skills/issue-graph/tests/fixtures/cycle .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --issues api#1 api#2 api#3 api#4 --publish-to 261; echo "EXIT=$?" ``` Reply: Граф **не опубликован**: в нём цикл. Скрипт завершился с exit 1 (`{"error": "not published: the graph has a cycle"}`), и в issue ничего не записано. **Цикл** (из «Циклы»): - api#1 → api#2 → api#3 → api#1 - в том же клубке связей ещё: api#5 (вне выборки), api#6 (вне выборки, закрыта) **Как его снять.** Человек удаляет в GitHub одну связь `blocked by` и запускает граф заново. Это повторяется, пока под «Циклы» не будет «Нет.». В клубок входят api#1, api#2, api#3, а также api#5 (вне выборки) и api#6 (вне выборки, закрыта). Какая связь лишняя, решает команда. Опубликовать граф можно будет после такого перезапуска. **In Progress с открытым блокером:** - api#1 ждёт api#3 и api#5. api#5 не входит в выборку, он есть в разделе «Вне выборки». Возможные варианты, решает человек: - сначала закрыть блокеры, потом продолжить api#1; - вернуть api#1 из «In Progress»; - удалить связь, если блокер устарел и api#1 его больше не ждёт. </details> <details><summary><code>03-cycle-no-publish</code> — Codex (round 3, <code>2d81cdb</code>)</summary> Tool calls: ```text /bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/issue-graph/SKILL.md' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc 'git remote -v' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc 'rg --files .agents/skills/issue-graph/tests/fixtures/cycle' # exit 0 /bin/bash -lc 'ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR=.agents/skills/issue-graph/tests/fixtures/cycle .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --issues api#1 api#2 api#3 api#4 --publish-to 261' # exit 1 ``` Reply: Не опубликовано в #​261: в графе есть цикл. [api#1](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/1) → [api#2](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/2) → [api#3](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/3) → [api#1](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/1). В том же клубке связей ещё [api#5](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/5) (вне выборки) и [api#6](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/6) (вне выборки, закрыта). Чтобы публикация стала возможной, человек должен убрать неверную связь `blocked by` в GitHub и повторять запуск, пока раздел «Циклы» не покажет «Нет.». Какая именно связь неверна, решает команда. В разделе «In Progress с открытым блокером»: api#1 ждёт api#3 и api#5 (вне выборки). Возможные решения: сначала завершить блокеры и затем продолжить api#1; вернуть api#1 из «In Progress»; либо убрать устаревшую связь, если задача больше не ждёт блокер. </details> <details><summary><code>04-in-progress-blocked</code> — Claude Code</summary> Tool calls: ```text [Skill] issue-graph ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR=.agents/skills/issue-graph/tests/fixtures/milestone .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 5"; echo "EXIT=$?" ``` Reply: **In Progress с открытым блокером**: такая задача одна. - **api#15** «Очередь пересборки индекса» ждёт две задачи: - **api#11** «Индекс символов репозитория» входит в «Спринт 5». - **api#90** «Стенд для нагрузочных прогонов» лежит вне выборки: у неё нет майлстоуна «Спринт 5», и в отчёте она стоит в разделе «Вне выборки» с пометкой «блокирует api#15». Что делать, решает человек. source.body:
## What

Part 2 of #268, api side. This is a byte-identical SYNC copy of larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6#184, made per `.agents/README.md` (Shared files: edit in ui, `cp`, `diff -r`).

- `scripts/issue_graph.py` — `--publish-to N|REF` (a bare `N` is `api#N`). The report goes to one comment whose first line is `<!-- issue-graph: <scope> -->`; a re-run with the same scope updates that comment instead of adding one. A graph with a cycle or a body over 65536 characters is never published. In fixture mode gh is never called, so a fixture run cannot post to GitHub. Without `--publish-to` the report is unchanged from part 1, except one line under a cycle (below).
- `tests/` — 165 offline tests, up from 96. They cover paging the comment listing past page 1, first-line marker matching, 404 → exit 2 / 403 → exit 3, non-api targets and the fixture write log, and they are mutation-checked.
- `examples/` — four golden request/outcome pairs; `SKILL.md` (one context, no sub-agents, so Codex runs it as is); `references/report.md`, `references/publishing.md`.
- Review round 1 (`a29c6e59`, ui `2d81cdb`): «Циклы» lists the rest of the cyclic component under the cycle line (`- в том же клубке связей ещё: …`, tagged `(вне выборки)` / `(закрыта)`), so the agent names closed and outside members instead of inferring them; the marker key escapes CR and LF (`%0D`, `%0A`), so a multi-line milestone title still matches its comment on a re-run.
- Per-repo edits made by hand: `issue-graph` in the `AGENTS.md` skills list and the count in `.agents/README.md` (8 → 9 here).

The full description and the design decisions are in larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6#184; the manual runs are summarised below, with full tool calls and replies there.

No new dependency: python3 stdlib only.

## Manual runs — Claude Code 2.1.310 and Codex 0.163.0

Each example's `input.md` body sent as the prompt from the ui worktree root (`claude -p`, `codex exec`); the skill is byte-identical here. Guard rails: a `gh` wrapper first on `PATH` that logged every call and let through only GraphQL queries and REST GETs; for fixture examples also an invalid `GH_TOKEN` and Codex's `read-only` sandbox. For the live `02` the wrapper additionally allowed exactly one POST on #261's comments and a PATCH of an api issue comment. Commands below are what the agent ran (`S=.agents/skills/issue-graph`).

| Example | Harness | Command run by the agent | Exit | Outcome |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `01-show-sprint` (live, read-only) | Claude Code | `$S/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4"` | 0 | Report shown, nothing published; #273 waits on #268 flagged; layer-1 issues already in progress/review named as taken; offer to publish to #261 |
| | Codex | same | 0 | Report shown, nothing published; #273 waits on #268 flagged; offer to publish to #261; also pasted the report's Mermaid block verbatim |
| `02-publish-rerun` turn 1 (live) | Claude Code | `$S/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4" --publish-to 261` | 0 | `created` — [#261 comment 6396929696](https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696) |
| turn 2 | Claude Code | same | 0 | `updated`, same URL |
| turn 1 / turn 2 | Codex | same | 0 / 0 | `updated` / `updated`, same URL |
| `03-cycle-no-publish` (fixture) | Claude Code | `ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR=$S/tests/fixtures/cycle $S/scripts/issue_graph.py --issues api#1 api#2 api#3 api#4 --publish-to 261` | 1 | «не опубликовано», cycle `api#1 → api#2 → api#3 → api#1`, plus api#5 (outside) and closed api#6 from the tangle line; the team picks the link; no re-run |
| | Codex | same | 1 | Same |
| `04-in-progress-blocked` (fixture) | Claude Code | `ISSUE_GRAPH_FIXTURE_DIR=$S/tests/fixtures/milestone $S/scripts/issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 5"` | 0 | api#15 waits on api#11 and api#90 (outside the scope); three options, the choice left to people |
| | Codex | same | 0 | Same |

Wrapper log for `02`: 1 POST, then 3 PATCHes of the same comment, nothing else written; afterwards #261 holds exactly one marked comment. `03` is from round 3 (after review round 1, on ui `2d81cdb`); the rest from round 2 (ui `abc0b96`; `SKILL.md` unchanged since except one item of the cycle reply). No fixture run reached GitHub.

## Why

#268 part 2: publishing for the sprint-start ritual (#273) — one comment in the «Спринт N» issue, updated in place on every re-run — plus the skill that drives the script. In api, `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` cover `.agents/`, so this copy is where CI lints the script.

## How to verify

```sh
uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy .
# skill tests and strict typing (not part of the required CI job — same decision as create-issue)

uv run mypy --strict .agents/skills/issue-graph/scripts/issue_graph.py .agents/skills/issue-graph/tests/test_issue_graph.py

```

source.body:
## What

Part 2 of #273: the sprint start ritual. Part 1, the `## 9. Спринты` section this extends, is merged in #357.

**`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`, `### Старт спринта` in §9.** A five-step table with who does what:

1. The tech lead creates «Спринт N» in both repos and names the «Спринт N» issue number.
2. Whoever files the sprint issues files them with the milestone and native links (blocked-by, parent epic) via `create-issue` (#262), and the tech lead marks the composition.
3. The tech lead builds the milestone graph with `issue-graph` (#268). A graph with a cycle (exit 1) is not published.
4. The tech lead publishes it with `--publish-to <issue>`. A re-run with the same milestone updates the same comment by its marker.
5. Issue leads (assignees) check their blockers in «In Progress с открытым блокером», the layer number in «Слои», and «Вне выборки». Each picks one option: finish the blocker first, move the issue out of In Progress, or drop a stale link.

Plus the show and publish commands for Спринт 4. The flags, section names and update-by-marker behaviour match `.agents/skills/issue-graph/SKILL.md` §2, §5, §7 and the script's output.

**First published graph** (Part 2 AC): https://github.com/larchanka-training/dmc-268-api-t6/issues/261#issuecomment-6396929696

- Published on 28.10 with `issue_graph.py --milestone "Спринт 4" --publish-to 261` → `{"published": "updated"}`, after the part 1 composition marking.
- It updated the comment of the #268 demo run from 25.10, which has the same marker `milestone=Спринт 4`.
- Contents: 75 issues (62 open, 13 closed), 42 blocking links, no cycles.
- In Progress with an open blocker: api#144 ← #130, api#273 ← #268, api#312 ← #306.

## Why

Part 2 of #273 Scope. A list of sprint issues becomes an order of work only through the dependency graph built at the start. #268 is merged and in AC Check; the tech lead let part 2 start before #268's acceptance (28.10).

- `git diff origin/main...origin/docs/273-sprint-start-graph` — one commit, one file: `### Старт спринта` appended to §9.
